Thanks again for the demo last month — the team at Clearwell found the inference economics examples really helpful. Our marketing lead asked whether Clearwell would be open to two small things: a short 60–90s testimonial video (onsite or remote) and a 20–30 minute analyst briefing for Gartner (they requested an end-user perspective).
